riel: Quick check — plan to open a short freeze window for invoices-v1.9 rollout tonight 2025-05-21 23:00-23:45 UTC. No schema changes during cordon. Please ack if you can be online. @hao @kelly

hao: Ack from infra. AMIs baked, jobs queued, canary image pushed.

kelly: QA ack — core invoice flows smoke passed. Running refunds/regression next.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: scheduling pin releases/v1.9.0 -> invoices-pool; awaiting confirm.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: pin applied pin_id=pin-6190012345-xyz

riel: If refunds 502s appear in canary >3 in 5m we stop. Proceeding to canary 1% now.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary started canary_id=canary-6190012345 cohort=inv-canary-1

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: metric pulse (5m): http_5xx 0.15%, p95 +4% — no gates hit.

kelly: QA expanded regressions running; will post if anything shows up.

hao: Infra: pool has 9% spare capacity; auto-burst to shared allowed per policy.

riel: OK continuing to 10% in 10m if no issues. Keep this thread for audit and handoffs.
